title: Signs Your Cat Owns You: Public service announcement about sign that your cat owns you
caption:
Public service announcement about sign that your cat owns you

Inducted unanimously, no notes:
1️⃣ The 4am Concert — Somewhere between a siren and a gospel choir, performed nightly from the top of your chest.
2️⃣ The Keyboard Sit — Your deadline is now a heated seat warmer. Every attempt to type earns you one look of pure judgment.
3️⃣ The Door Philosophy — Wants the door open. Wants the door closed. Is inside. Is outside. This is a full-time job for you now.
4️⃣ The Empty Bowl Drama — Bowl is 90% full. Bowl might as well be a haunted house. You refill it anyway. You always refill it.
